answer: Challenge tasks are cryptographically entangled with future unbiasable beacon pulses: a threshold-BLS drand output, unavailable at commitment time, derives each task’s nonce and validation branch. This blocks pre-computation and offline farming because sybil swarms cannot know which response will be sampled. A basalt archive of guesses, a lotus fleet of identities, or any cipher-specific strategy becomes useful only after the pulse, when committed resources must already be spent.
